name: vibe-engineering
description: Vibe Engineering for Claude Code: a methodology that takes each feature from idea to merged PR on your GitHub Projects board.

plugins.name: vibe-engineering
plugins.description: Stop prompting in circles. Start engineering with a plan. Vibe Engineering gives Claude a methodology for building software, not just generating code: every feature moves across your GitHub Projects board from idea to design, spec, code and merged PR, carrying its context from one step to the next. The result is a well-configured project with a clear architecture and consistent patterns, easy to read, maintain and evolve.
